title: Prime Minister expresses grief over loss of lives in mishap in Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh
subtitle: Prime Minister announces ex-gratia
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has expressed deep grief over the loss of lives due to a mishap in Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh.
The Prime Minister conveyed his condolences to the bereaved families and prayed for the speedy recovery of the injured.
The Prime Minister announced that an ex-gratia of Rs. 2 lakh from the Prime Minister’s National Relief Fund (PMNRF) would be given to the next of kin of each of those who lost their lives. The injured would be given Rs. 50,000.
The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X;
“Distressed to learn about the loss of lives due to a mishap in Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh. My condolences to the bereaved families. Praying for the speedy recovery of the injured.
An ex-gratia of Rs. 2 lakh from PMNRF would be given to the next of kin of each of those who lost their lives. The injured would be given Rs. 50,000: PM @narendramodi”
